methodology: exception-capture-completeness-v0.1.0: rules match deterministic scenario signals. Global block signals suppress outbound packets. Matching rules emit candidate packet classes; they do not prove source truth or authorize repo mutation.

rules.description: A repo created or discovered a reusable digital asset that may help other repos.

emit.rationale: Reusable assets should be suggested to DAD with provenance and pointers so the library can classify them.

applies_when: The asset is reusable beyond the source repo and can be described without raw private content.
does_not_apply_when: The artifact is routine source code, private-only, duplicate, or cannot be summarized safely.
rules.danger_if_missed: DAD misses useful assets and future repos repeat work.

rules.description: A repeated coding, testing, red-team, or governance workflow should become a harness candidate.

emit.rationale: Coding-improvement harnesses should enter DAD's harness library as candidate capabilities.

applies_when: The workflow can be reused by Codex, Claude, Cursor, or future agents.
does_not_apply_when: The workflow is one-off, unvalidated, or requires private raw data.
rules.danger_if_missed: High-leverage coding improvements stay trapped in one repo or chat.

rules.description: A repo created, updated, retired, or replaced an agent skill or skill pointer.

emit.rationale: DAD is the skill library and must know lifecycle updates without copying full skills into repos.

applies_when: The skill affects future AI agent behavior or should be checked out by other repos.
does_not_apply_when: The change is private scratch prompt text or not safe to summarize.
rules.danger_if_missed: Agents use stale or conflicting skill guidance.

rules.description: A reusable template, managed block, or downstream pointer contract changed.

emit.rationale: Repos using templates need candidate upgrade notices and local review paths.

applies_when: The template may affect enrolled repo behavior or future repo starts.
does_not_apply_when: The edit is local wording with no contract, cadence, or managed-surface effect.
rules.danger_if_missed: Downstream repos retain stale instructions and miss new capture obligations.

rules.description: A structured review workflow created reusable DAD mail or issue logic but exposed an exception-lake or governance gap.

emit.rationale: The LawFirm-os-intake missed-capture specimen should create both workflow mail and an exception seed automatically.

applies_when: A review workflow yields reusable structure plus a gap DAD should learn from.
does_not_apply_when: The review is private, unstructured, or has no reusable workflow/gap evidence.
rules.danger_if_missed: Lowell has to notice the pattern manually and DAD fails to learn from review work.

rules.description: A repo produced a reusable architecture reference, design pattern, or buildout map.

emit.rationale: Reusable architecture references should be offered to DAD for future repo consults.

applies_when: The design can help new repos or repo families.
does_not_apply_when: The design is source-specific and unsafe to summarize.
rules.danger_if_missed: Future repos miss proven architecture patterns.

rules.description: Governance map, source authority, managed path, or human gate drift is observed.

emit.rationale: Governance drift should be visible to DAD and target repos without mutating source authority.

applies_when: A governance or managed-surface contract differs from reviewed DAD policy.
does_not_apply_when: The difference is expected local source authority and no DAD contract is involved.
rules.danger_if_missed: DAD can apply stale governance assumptions to protected or public repos.

rules.description: A governed artifact was added or changed but not registered into the manifests, suites, generated snapshots, AI navigation, catalogs, or maps that make it discoverable and enforceable.

emit.rationale: Registration drift creates false-green governance: the new artifact can validate locally while future agents, suites, manifests, or catalogs never see it.

applies_when: An agent adds or changes a schema, validator, generated report, template, red-team fixture, governance config, asset catalog entry, workflow map, data map, prompt, review intake, or reusable workflow asset.
does_not_apply_when: The artifact is a scratch note, generated cache, temporary local experiment, or intentionally ungoverned file documented as excluded from future-agent routing.
rules.danger_if_missed: Future agents may miss the artifact, validators may pass stale evidence, DAD may not discover a reusable asset, and readiness claims may rely on incomplete manifests or suite output.

rules.description: A data movement or sensitivity-boundary issue affects DAD mail, public release, or exception capture.

emit.rationale: Data-boundary changes must be candidate notices and exception events because they can leak private context.

applies_when: DAD movement rules or public/private boundaries may be affected.
does_not_apply_when: The data is local-only and unrelated to DAD movement or public-facing repos.
rules.danger_if_missed: Private-origin context could reach public-facing repos without release.

rules.description: DAD mail itself needs a new message type, field, route, cadence, or dedupe behavior.

emit.rationale: Mail contract changes need DAD review and capture-surface update tests.

applies_when: An observed repo need requires new DAD mail fields or behavior.
does_not_apply_when: The existing mail schema handles the case safely.
rules.danger_if_missed: Repos keep sending incomplete packets after DAD's needs change.

rules.description: A new exception type or capture contract is needed.

emit.rationale: Unknown exception patterns should create a taxonomy suggestion and a candidate exception event.

applies_when: Existing exception taxonomy cannot represent the observed safe metadata.
does_not_apply_when: A reviewed event type already fits.
rules.danger_if_missed: Novel failure classes collapse into `other` and cannot be learned from.

rules.description: A red-team, premortem, Fable, Claude, Codex, Cursor, security, or human review found a material issue.

emit.rationale: Material review findings are exception-lake seeds even before a code failure occurs.

applies_when: The finding affects correctness, governance, safety, privacy, or future-agent behavior.
does_not_apply_when: The review is only style preference or duplicates an existing event.
rules.danger_if_missed: DAD cannot learn from external review feedback.

rules.description: An exception was fixed, accepted, rejected, reopened, or rolled back with evidence.

emit.rationale: The lake learns from fixes only when outcomes and validation refs are recorded.

applies_when: A tracked event has a closure, fix, validation, accepted-risk, or rollback decision.
does_not_apply_when: No event is tracked or the closure lacks validation/rationale.
rules.danger_if_missed: DAD accumulates open failures without learning which fixes worked.

rules.description: A task produced a reusable lesson, DAD need, offering update, or context-pack calibration signal.

emit.rationale: Reusable learning should be routed as bounded candidate mail and, when missed by the agent, as an exception event.

applies_when: The lesson affects future agent task order, DAD offerings, or capture rules.
does_not_apply_when: The observation is routine, duplicate, hidden reasoning, or not reusable.
rules.danger_if_missed: DAD repeats the same mistake because the lesson never enters the loop.

authority_boundary: Capture rules are deterministic tests for expected repo emissions. They do not prove truth, approve public release, or authorize DAD to mutate target repositories.
